description: ResOpsBR+CARS combines operating time series for 142 Brazilian reservoirs with hydrometeorology and catchment, dam and reservoir attributes. Its CARAVAN-style organization supports comparisons between process and data-driven models. This resource is provided by Casado Rodríguez, Jesús; Disperati, Juliana; Salamon, Peter. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Underlying source products and modelling choices differ; this documented national dataset series is intended for reuse across model families. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
